title: Say It With Colour! Rethinking Colour In The Bathroom
bodyHtml:
Bold Bathware that Guides Design

When we think about using colour in bathroom design, the mind naturally drifts toward walls, tiles, or vanities. But at Studio Bagno, we're reimagining how colour can define your bathroom, starting from where it matters most—the bathware.

The right hue on a basin, bath, or even your toilet can create a space that is as bold or serene as you desire.

Setting the Tone

Instead of letting tiles or surfaces dictate your palette, let your bathware lead the way. Think of your basin, bath, and toilet as sculptural elements where you can make a statement.

Choose colours that enhance these pieces, allowing them to stand out or complement the overall design. If you're opting for a dramatic effect or a more minimalist touch, bathware offers an exciting way to bring colour to the forefront.

Dramatic Matte Black

Matte black fixtures will always have a place in contemporary bathrooms, offering a sleek and dramatic aesthetic. Their subtle texture brings a depth that enhances any design, especially when contrasted with lighter tones.

Soft Pastel Serenity

For those looking for a more delicate approach, pastel hues can soften the bathroom’s overall feel, making the space more inviting and tranquil. Picture powder pink basins or soft mint-green baths for a touch of calm sophistication.

Glossy Colours for Bold Expression

Gloss finishes are making a comeback across European designs. Bold shades of gloss colour in fixtures—like deep navy or rich emerald green—can add a contemporary twist to your bathroom while catching the light in all the right ways.

Is Colour Right for Me?

Introducing colour through bathware offers a rare opportunity to elevate your bathroom's look. By starting with striking basins, toilets, or baths, the surrounding elements can play a supporting role, creating a cohesive and intentional design that feels fresh and inspired.

When paired thoughtfully with neutral or textured backgrounds, your coloured fixtures will be the stars of the show.

Thanks for Reading!
